create_BaseGeometryConfig: create a BaseGeometryConfig instance with n_rho and face_centers for radial grid geometry
validate_BaseGeometryConfig: validate BaseGeometryConfig ensures n_rho is at least 4 and face_centers spans 0 to 1
get_face_centers: get face_centers from BaseGeometryConfig computing from n_rho if not provided
compare_BaseGeometryConfig: compare two BaseGeometryConfig instances for equality using face_centers and hires_factor
build_geometry_config: build a geometry configuration with default n_rho of 25 when neither n_rho nor face_centers is set
